Added an invisible, invulnerable building tier with collision that can host items, useful for blocking areas or creating floating displays.
Improved Warhead Garage Door colliders for finer, more precise movement and updated its prefab LODs and scripts.

Adjusted interaction order so leading interaction remains default before petting livestock.
Fixed animals not attacking players standing next to vehicles.
Prevented bases from decaying despite TC upkeep on high-entity-count servers by adjusting decay tick budgeting.
Scarecrows now work reliably during the Halloween 2026 event.
Turn transitions are now smooth; player actions no longer get dropped or delayed.
Tattoo painting no longer causes unintended fading of new ink.
Dungeon bugs fixed, improving stability and preventing players from getting stuck.
Crab and jellyfish gathering jobs now complete successfully, fixing previous errors that prevented resource collection.

2026-10-16.summary:
### Combat
- Fixed delay where attached grenades were invisible until a viewmodel event, ensuring they appear correctly when spawned.

### Building & Structures
- Added an invisible, invulnerable building tier with collision that can host items, useful for blocking areas or creating floating displays.
- Improved Warhead Garage Door colliders for finer, more precise movement and updated its prefab LODs and scripts.

### Server & Settings
- Resolved an issue where joining clients reset server convars, including gamemode settings, when using C+S.

### Interactions
- Adjusted interaction order so leading interaction remains default before petting livestock.

### NPC & AI
- Fixed animals not attacking players standing next to vehicles.

### Upkeep & Decay
- Prevented bases from decaying despite TC upkeep on high-entity-count servers by adjusting decay tick budgeting.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Scarecrows now work reliably during the Halloween 2026 event.
- Turn transitions are now smooth; player actions no longer get dropped or delayed.
- Tattoo painting no longer causes unintended fading of new ink.
- Dungeon bugs fixed, improving stability and preventing players from getting stuck.
- Crab and jellyfish gathering jobs now complete successfully, fixing previous errors that prevented resource collection.

items.text: The Lighthouse now requires repair to restore its light and unlock the deep‑sea area.
Clan features are disabled in Softcore and the clan table is restricted in both Softcore and Hardcore, preventing its use and fixing tech‑tree displays.
Grenade throws now have consistent trajectory and release timing, fixing sideways swings and out‑of‑sync releases.
The nailgun’s missing muzzle point has been restored, allowing it to be mounted on turrets without errors.
Snapshot send budgeting limits entity snapshot bursts, reducing client stutter when loading large bases (new server.snapshotsendrate setting).
The boat edit‑mode UI no longer shows edit privileges for boats the player isn’t authorized to modify.
Signs with identical content are no longer cleared unexpectedly.

2026-10-15.summary:
### World Structures
- The Lighthouse now requires repair to restore its light and unlock the deep‑sea area.

### Clans & Game Modes
- Clan features are disabled in Softcore and the clan table is restricted in both Softcore and Hardcore, preventing its use and fixing tech‑tree displays.

### Combat & Grenades
- Grenade throws now have consistent trajectory and release timing, fixing sideways swings and out‑of‑sync releases.

### Weapons
- The nailgun’s missing muzzle point has been restored, allowing it to be mounted on turrets without errors.

### Performance
- Snapshot send budgeting limits entity snapshot bursts, reducing client stutter when loading large bases (new server.snapshotsendrate setting).

### World Interactions
- The boat edit‑mode UI no longer shows edit privileges for boats the player isn’t authorized to modify.
- Signs with identical content are no longer cleared unexpectedly.
